SELECT * FROM ( SELECT fb.id AS feeBillId, 1 AS businessType, fb.id AS businessId, '物业费' AS businessTypeText, fb.bill_period AS businessRef, fb.property_id AS propertyId, up.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(p.owner_name, ''), CONCAT('用户', up.user_id)) AS ownerName, fb.bill_period AS billPeriod, fb.amount AS amount, fb.paid_amount AS paidAmount, fb.due_date AS dueDate FROM fee_bill fb INNER JOIN property p ON p.id = fb.property_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN user_property up ON up.property_id = fb.property_id AND up.is_deleted = 0 AND up.id = ( SELECT up2.id FROM user_property up2 WHERE up2.property_id = fb.property_id AND up2.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY up2.is_primary DESC, up2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = up.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fb.is_deleted = 0 AND fb.status <> 2 AND fb.due_date < NOW()
UNION ALL
SELECT po.id AS feeBillId, 2 AS businessType, po.id AS businessId, '停车费' AS businessTypeText, COALESCE(NULLIF(po.vehicle_no, ''), CONCAT('停车订单#', po.id)) AS businessRef, po.property_id AS propertyId, po.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(p.owner_name, ''), CONCAT('用户', po.user_id)) AS ownerName, NULL AS billPeriod, po.amount AS amount, 0 AS paidAmount, po.end_time AS dueDate FROM parking_order po LEFT JOIN property p ON p.id = po.property_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = po.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status <> 1 AND po.end_time < NOW()
UNION ALL
SELECT rfb.id AS feeBillId, 3 AS businessType, rfb.id AS businessId, '维修费' AS businessTypeText, CONCAT('工单#', rfb.order_id) AS businessRef, rfb.property_id AS propertyId, rfb.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(p.owner_name, ''), CONCAT('用户', rfb.user_id)) AS ownerName, NULL AS billPeriod, rfb.amount AS amount, 0 AS paidAmount, rfb.due_date AS dueDate FROM repair_fee_bill rfb LEFT JOIN property p ON p.id = rfb.property_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = rfb.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rfb.is_deleted = 0 AND rfb.status <> 1 AND rfb.due_date < NOW() ) overdue_bills ORDER BY dueDate ASC, businessType ASC, businessId ASC
